title: Skill Workflow Evaluation Scenario
description: One end-to-end scenario run by scripts/run_behavioral_evals.py, with and without the skill, and graded against required/forbidden behaviors.

kind.description: pressure: the prompt argues for skipping the workflow (time pressure, authority, sunk cost). The skill should hold anyway.

scenario.description: The prompt sent verbatim to the agent.

fixture.description: Human-readable note on the fixture. Machine-readable inputs live in workspace_files / reference_answer.

workspace_files.description: Repo paths (files or directories) copied into the agent's throwaway workspace. Never put reference answers here.

to.description: Destination path inside the workspace (default: basename of `from`).

reference_answer.description: Repo path shown ONLY to the grader, never to the agent.

max_turns.description: Override the runner's default turn limit for this scenario.
